```{r bootstrap, include=FALSE}
# ============================================================
#  UBAH DUA NILAI INI untuk modul Anda:
nomor_modul <- 1
topik_modul <- "Judul Modul Anda"
# ============================================================
# Menulis preamble tema BPS dari package modulstis (self-bootstrapping).
if (requireNamespace("modulstis", quietly = TRUE)) {
  th <- modulstis::theme_factory("bps")
  writeLines(
    th$preamble(number = nomor_modul, topic = topik_modul, variant = "modul"),
    "preamble.tex"
  )
} else {
  stop("Package 'modulstis' belum terpasang. Jalankan install.packages('modulstis').")
}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "",
  fig.align = "center", fig.pos = "H", out.width = "88%"
)
options(width = 95, digits = 4, scipen = 999)
knitr::knit_hooks$set(output = function(x, options) {
  paste0("\\begin{routbox}\n\\begin{verbatim}\n", x,
         "\\end{verbatim}\n\\end{routbox}\n")
})
```

```{r cover, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
th <- modulstis::theme_factory("bps")
cat(th$cover(
  number    = nomor_modul,
  title     = toupper(topik_modul),
  pertemuan = "Pertemuan Minggu ke-XX",
  sub_cpmk  = "Sub-CPMK XX: tuliskan capaian pembelajaran di sini."
))
```
